method.candidate_pairwise_delta: each scored candidate minus paired F-source on that candidate's own GT-known/present-valid support; differing supports are reported separately
method.common_support: GT known; Source candidate present-valid and finite F-source IoU; every prelock-displayed candidate is present-valid and has finite candidate IoU at the same original observation slot
method.missing_or_unknown: excluded and represented as null/unknown; never filled with zero
method.oracle_role: offline diagnostic only; does not modify METHOD_REFERENCE_LOCK
method.oracle_tie_break: exact ties resolve to lowest numeric candidate ID
method.pool_delta: max displayed-candidate mean anchor IoU on strict common support minus F-source mean anchor IoU on that same support
method.teacher_delta: locked teacher-selected candidate mean anchor IoU minus F-source mean anchor IoU on strict common support

scope.fixed_cases_source: ROSTER_LOCK intersected exactly with CANDIDATE_INPUT_BARRIER and METHOD_REFERENCE_LOCK

checks: unknown GT and missing candidate support are excluded, not zero-filled
oracle exact ties resolve by ascending candidate ID
locked teacher ID joins to that candidate's score
IoU fraction validator rejects percentage-scaled values
